segments.title: Replay the last 15 seconds
segments.say: Missed what someone said? Your Apple Watch can replay the last fifteen seconds.

segments.title: Double-press the Digital Crown
segments.say: It's called Live Rewind. Double-press the Digital Crown to see it as text.

segments.title: Text vanishes after screen dims
segments.say: The text vanishes after the screen dims.

segments.title: It chimes, even on silent
segments.say: And it chimes, even on silent.

segments.title: Who gets it
segments.say: You need a Series 12 or Ultra 4, and an iPhone 16 or later.
